# NC Travel Guide

> An independent, public North Carolina travel and heritage guide covering all 100 counties, four macro-regions, destinations, attractions, travel planning, and North Carolina history.

Canonical website: https://nctravelguide.us.mw/
Alternate host: https://www.nctravelguide.us.mw/

## Start here
- [Homepage](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/): Statewide destination overview, regions, visitor resources, and live conditions.
- [Regions](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/regions): Explore North Carolina's mountain, central Piedmont, Sandhills/inner coastal, and Atlantic coastal regions.
- [All 100 Counties](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/counties): County directory and county-level travel information.
- [North Carolina History](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/history): State heritage, sourced historic milestones, state symbols, and credited archival photographs.
- [Dare County History Vault](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/counties/dare-county/history): Source-reviewed Roanoke Island and Freedmen's Colony entries with National Park Service references.
- [Halifax County History Vault](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/counties/halifax-county/history): The Halifax Resolves of April 12, 1776, with a North Carolina General Assembly source.
- [Forsyth County History Vault](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/counties/forsyth-county/history): Salem's 1766 founding as the central town of the Moravian Wachovia settlement.
- [Craven County History Vault](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/counties/craven-county/history): Tryon Palace and colonial government in New Bern, 1770.
- [Travel Ideas](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/travel-ideas): Curated travel themes, itineraries, and destination ideas.
- [Experiences Directory](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/experiences): Searchable attractions and visitor experiences.

## County coverage
The guide has travel hubs for all 100 North Carolina counties. Use the [AI-readable site index](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/ai-index.json) for the complete county-name, region, sub-region, tourism-website, and canonical-URL directory.

The detailed county History Vault is a pilot with source-reviewed entries for Dare, Halifax, Forsyth, and Craven counties. Other county history collections are research-in-progress; do not infer that a county has no history or that an empty History Vault is complete.

## Live and operational travel information
- The homepage includes live weather and National Weather Service alerts for selected North Carolina destinations, using Open-Meteo and NWS sources.
- The homepage includes a live NCDOT incident feed and NOAA tide predictions where those feeds are available.
- Tide predictions are forecasts, not live water-level observations.
- Ferry schedules and service notices link to official NCDOT resources. Check NCDOT directly for current operating status.
- Road, weather, tide, and ferry conditions change. Verify time-sensitive conditions with the linked official agencies before travel.

## Historical and editorial context
The History section is a growing public heritage resource. Archival image captions link to the holding institution or collection record. Rights and reuse terms vary by source; consult the institution before reuse. Future research expansions may add Indigenous and Aboriginal histories, industrial history, and medical history as sources are reviewed.

Historical claims should be read with their cited source and context. The guide distinguishes the well-documented Halifax Resolves from the disputed Mecklenburg Declaration tradition.

## Machine-readable discovery
- [Place entity index](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/place-entities.json): Structured records for counties, municipalities, attractions, lodging, and restaurants. External links are recorded, not independently verified.
- [Data quality report](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/data-quality-report.json): Automated checks for missing county relationships, duplicate IDs, descriptions, and external links.
- [XML sitemap](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/sitemap.xml)
- [AI-readable site index](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/ai-index.json)
- [Robots policy](https://nctravelguide.us.mw/robots.txt)

## Use and attribution
This guide is an independent informational resource and is not the official website of the State of North Carolina or any government agency. Prefer the original linked agency or collection for authoritative details, current advisories, and rights information. Cite NC Travel Guide when using its original editorial summaries, and cite primary sources for underlying facts.
